name: unslop-text
description: Rewrites padded, stock or stiff text so it reads plain and natural, then checks the result: a changed number, code block, link or placeholder fails, and a lost name, negation, hedge or condition warns. Works on English text: game and app UI strings (JSON, .xcstrings, .properties, .strings, Android strings.xml, CSV), README and API docs, articles, emails, release notes, landing pages, PR descriptions, FAQs, and long documents. Cuts filler, stock phrases and hype, and applies an 80% STE-style clarity pass (short active sentences, plain words) while keeping the author's voice. Use when the user asks to unslop, simplify, tighten, clean up, polish or copy-edit text, to cut filler or marketing language, to make strings or docs consistent, to review writing for padding and stock phrases, or says text sounds padded, generic or robotic.
